string_tension_from_sag — DRIVE diabolo op

• Data kinds: signal × signal × signal × scalar → table

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.string_tension_from_sag(p_left, p_right, p_diabolo, mass: 'float', *, accel=None, g: 'float' = 9.81) -> 'dict' (to call the implementation directly, import diabolo; diabolo.string_tension_from_sag(p_left, p_right, p_diabolo, mass: 'float', *, accel=None, g: 'float' = 9.81) -> 'dict'; from the registry, opsdrive.get("string_tension_from_sag"))

Usage

Computes the tension from the V shape of the string (the 2 stick tips and the axle position) (frictionless pulley = equal tension on both sides).

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

T (û_L + û_R) = m (a − g⃗) の最小二乗: T = m (a − g⃗)·n / |n|²、n = û_L + û_R(û は軸 → 棒の単位ベクトル)。静止(accel = None) なら T = m g / (sin α_L + sin α_R)(α = 糸の水平からの角)と同じ。残差(釣り合いの破れ)も返す —— 大きければ「加速度の入れ忘れ / 摩擦 / 弾性」の警報。Raises ValueError: 形、質量 ≤ 0、軸が棒と重なる。
